items.subject: The vast pale tailings dump at the old Colonial mine, its flanks cut by water
items.action: thin rivulets of runoff carry loose blue-grey tailings downslope into a dry creek line
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction follows the water channels from the dump toward the open plain
items.setting: Abandoned Colonial mine site below red Hamersley Range cliffs, Wittenoom, Pilbara, present day
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre cliffs, blue-grey tailings, dusty pale-blue sky
items.props_detail: a fan of wet blue-grey sediment spreading at the foot of the dump
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: still dawn air, long shadows, slow water the only movement in a silent valley
items.narration_anchor: Los relaves del vertedero de Colonial se van con el agua.

items.subject: Deep erosion gullies eaten into the edge of the tailings heap
items.action: collapsed gully walls spill blue-grey waste into a stony creek bed
items.gaze_interaction: focal line runs down the gully toward the creek
items.setting: Margin of the Colonial tailings dump where it meets a dry watercourse, Wittenoom Gorge
items.color_palette: rust red rock, grey-blue waste, ochre dust, bleached stones
items.props_detail: a slumped gully lip trailing blue-grey grit over red boulders
items.camera_angle: low angle from the creek bed looking up the gully
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: motionless air, cold shade in the gully, sunlit ridge above
items.narration_anchor: Un informe técnico lo marcó como la fuente principal y la vía del asbesto:

items.subject: A braided dry creek winding through red floodplain toward the distant Fortescue River line
items.action: pale sediment trails along the creek beds and still pools stretch toward the river plain
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction leads from the gorge mouth out to the far river line on the horizon
items.setting: Floodplains below Wittenoom Gorge, Fortescue catchment, Pilbara, present day
items.color_palette: red earth, spinifex olive, grey-blue sediment, silver pool water, hazy blue sky
items.props_detail: a chain of shallow pools gleaming along the creek bed
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: vast quiet plain, mist lifting off the pools, no movement but light
items.narration_anchor: la erosión, los lechos de arroyo, las pozas, las llanuras de inundación hacia el río Fortescue.

items.subject: Blue fibrous residue at the edge of a dried-up creek pool
items.action: receding water has left a crust of blue fibres drying in cracked mud
items.gaze_interaction: focal point on the tide line where wet mud turns to dry crust
items.setting: Shrinking rock pool in a Pilbara creek bed downstream of Wittenoom
items.color_palette: cracked red-brown mud, faint blue fibre streaks, ochre stones
items.props_detail: a curled flake of dried mud flecked with blue fibres
items.lens_technique: shallow depth of field, macro lens
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: dry stillness, fine dust lifting in the low light
items.narration_anchor: Fibras azules que el agua deja donde se seca.

items.subject: A remote creek channel far beyond the contaminated zone, a lone weathered survey stake on its bank
items.action: thin blue traces lie in the channel sand far from any fence or marker
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction from the stake along the empty channel into open country
items.setting: Open spinifex country outside the marked Wittenoom contaminated area, 2021
items.color_palette: red sand, faded timber, olive spinifex, faint blue streaks, clear dusty sky
items.props_detail: a sun-bleached timber survey stake with faded flagging
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: empty land, long stake shadow, wind stirring the spinifex
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintiuno, una nota ambiental registró fibras en canales de arroyos fuera de la zona marcada como contaminada.

items.subject: The deserted Wittenoom townsite within the immense Fortescue catchment
items.action: creeks thread out from the abandoned town and gorge across the endless plain
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction sweeps from the town ruins to the river basin horizon
items.setting: Abandoned Wittenoom and surrounding Hamersley Range country, present day
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre ranges, weathered grey iron, hints of blue tailings, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: a faint blue-grey stain spreading along the drainage lines
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: enormous silent basin, light slowly filling the valley
items.narration_anchor: El mismo informe advirtió que, sin intervención, el aporte de asbesto a la cuenca del Fortescue puede seguir durante cientos de años.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Banjima man around 70, thin and frail, beside a middle-aged Latin American visitor in a plain shirt
items.action: the two men sit together on low camp chairs in red dirt, the visitor leaning in to listen
items.gaze_interaction: the elder looks out toward the gorge, the visitor turned toward him
items.setting: Open red country near Wittenoom Gorge, Banjima land, 2023
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre cliffs, faded khaki and blue cotton, dusty sky
items.props_detail: a worn wide-brimmed hat resting on the elder's knee
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: quiet, the elder's shoulders bowed and breath shallow, warm low light
items.narration_anchor: Es tierra Banjima. En dos mil veintitrés, Marcos Orellana visitó Australia y se sentó con Maitland Parker, un anciano Banjima.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Banjima man around 70, gaunt, lined weathered face, sun-faded work shirt
items.action: he stands alone at the edge of a creek bed, refusing to step away from his country
items.gaze_interaction: face toward camera, wet eyes, chin lifted, the gorge behind him
items.setting: Creek bed below the red walls of Wittenoom Gorge, Banjima country, 2023
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre cliffs, faded blue shirt, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: a hand-carved walking stick planted in the red dirt
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: small figure in a vast quiet gorge, tear tracks catching the low sun
items.narration_anchor: «Todavía lloro por mi territorio, pero eso está arraigado en mí; simplemente no puedo alejarme de él», dijo Parker.

items.subject: An empty camp chair facing the gorge, a worn wide-brimmed hat left on its seat
items.action: the chair stands vacant in the red dirt as dust drifts past
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction from the empty chair out to the creek and cliffs
items.setting: The same creek bank in Banjima country near Wittenoom, 2024
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre cliffs, faded canvas, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: the elder's walking stick leaning against the chair
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the slopes
items.mood: absence, long shadow of the chair, still air
items.narration_anchor: Maitland Parker murió de mesotelioma en dos mil veinticuatro.

items.subject: A small group of Aboriginal Banjima men and women of mixed ages, seen from behind, before a pale stone courthouse
items.action: they climb the courthouse steps together, one older woman holding a folder to her chest
items.gaze_interaction: figures face the tall entrance doors, read by form against the stone
items.setting: Federal Court building exterior, Perth, Western Australia
items.color_palette: pale sandstone, grey concrete, ochre and earth-toned clothing, clear morning sky
items.props_detail: a battered cardboard folder of documents held close
items.lighting: soft early-morning light, low sun raking across the facade
items.mood: small figures against a monumental facade, steady slow steps
items.narration_anchor: Dos años después, Gordon Legal presentó en nombre de BNTAC un proceso contra Australia Occidental en el Tribunal Federal.

items.subject: A permanent steel-and-earth barricade cutting the road into the old town and gorge
items.action: the barricade blocks the cracked road, beyond it only wind and red earth
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction past the barricade down the empty road to the distant ruins
items.setting: Entrance road to abandoned Wittenoom and Wittenoom Gorge, 2024
items.color_palette: rust steel, red earth, ochre dust, faded grey bitumen, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: a heaped earth bund with a rusted steel gate across the road
items.lighting: pale dawn, wind-blown dust softening the light
items.mood: empty road, dust streaming over the barrier, nothing moving beyond
items.narration_anchor: Nadie ha empezado a limpiar. En los accesos al pueblo y desfiladero hay bloqueos.

items.subject: A sun-faded government warning sign bolted to the gorge-road barricade
items.action: the sign rattles in the wind before the closed road into the gorge
items.gaze_interaction: focal point on the sign, red cliffs and empty road behind
items.setting: Barricaded access to Wittenoom Gorge, Pilbara, 2024
items.color_palette: faded red and white enamel, rust, red earth, ochre cliffs, dusty sky
items.props_detail: the dented metal warning sign with peeling paint
items.lighting: pale dawn, wind-blown dust softening the light
items.mood: whistling wind, dust haze, an untouched land behind the barrier
